reason: Provides deterministic local Markdown knowledge-base write and quick-read tools, including note creation, keyword search, note retrieval, and timeline updates.

summaries.zh: 将智能体连接到配置的本地 Markdown 知识库，用于写入、搜索、查看笔记并追加时间线记录。
summaries.en: Connects an agent to a configured local Markdown knowledge base for writing, searching, viewing notes, and appending timeline entries.

capabilities: Writes typed Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter to a configured local knowledge-base directory
Searches notes by keywords and returns matching metadata and snippets
Reads and returns note content by title, path, or tag
Appends timestamped entries to a local timeline file
